lessons_used: sign_in, copy changes were consistently helpful, winning 3 out of 4 tests (+2.2% average after noise correction).
adoption, redesign changes were helpful in 2 out of 4 tests (+2.3% average after noise correction), while the remaining 2 showed no clear effect.
home, wait_info, home, notification, and sign_in, hint changes consistently showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
home, new_flow changes consistently failed to show positive impact across 2 tests, resulting in no clear effect or worse performance.
finish, new_screen changes generally failed after an initial win, with recent tests performing worse.
Predictions remained generally too high compared to noise-corrected results, and evidence remains thin for categories with only 1 test.

candidates.title: Deferred Account Creation Sequence Reorder
candidates.change: Reorder the onboarding flow so account sign-in occurs after pet adoption and certificate creation.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion is 80.8% with a 567s mean duration; allowing users to create their pet first builds ownership before account creation.

candidates.title: Grid Companion Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Transform the pet choice view into a grid layout with visual preview cards and animated mascots.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest funnel conversion at 70.3% and a 1017s mean time. Previous adoption redesigns showed a +2.3% lift.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Pre-Adoption Companion Preference Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated preference screening step prior to selecting a companion.
candidates.why: High median (89s) and mean (1017s) time in adoption indicates users need clearer structured guidance before committing to a pet.

new_companion_quiz.headline: Find Your Ideal Companion
new_companion_quiz.body: Select the personality and activity level that matches your daily desktop routine.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Interactive Home Welcome Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home introduction screen into a stage layout featuring an interactive pet mascot and control guide.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple tickets reporting confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.

home_welcome.text: Right-click your pet anytime to summon desktop controls, hide, or interact.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen preserves its essential functions.

candidates.score_note: Finish step redesigns have performed poorly in past tests (-4.4%), and building an interactive layout requires high development effort.

candidates.title: Story Scroll Path Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign path selection into a full story scroll layout with interactive animated path previews.
candidates.why: Choose path step takes a mean time of 514s, showing that users hesitate when choosing their initial onboarding route.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Stage Layout Adoption Certificate View
candidates.change: Rebuild the adoption certificate summary into a stage layout with centered pet animations.
candidates.why: Improving visual feedback during adoption completion boosts user investment right before the waiting screen phase.

guard.reason: replacement for 'adoption_certificate.certificate' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'preview'] with an asset:certificate/ asset

candidates.title: Multi-Device Pet Sync Account Copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body to highlight safe cloud synchronization and pet retrieval across devices.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in again, making account sync messaging critical.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe Across Devices
sign_in.body: Your pet customization and progress are saved to your cloud account so you never lose your companion.

guard.reason: Copy update for sign-in is accurate and contains no prohibited references.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses 8 support emails with a sign_in copy change, a pattern that consistently yielded +2.2% lift across 4 previous tests.

candidates.title: Account Data Retention Sign-In Copy
candidates.change: Clarify sign-in subtext to state that re-authenticating restores existing pets rather than starting fresh.
candidates.why: Addresses the top support complaint (8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after re-login). Sign-in copy tests average +2.2% gain.

sign_in.headline: Restore & Secure Your Pet Account
sign_in.body: Logging in connects your active desktop pet to your permanent account. Re-sign in anytime to restore lost pets.

guard.reason: Sign-in copy revision clearly explains data retention without dark patterns.

candidates.score_note: Targets top support issue (8 emails) via a low-cost sign_in copy update, matching historical +2.2% average lift.

candidates.title: Two Column Photo Upload Layout
candidates.change: Reframe the custom photo upload step into a two-column layout with photo quality previews and tips.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails reporting custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results.

guard.reason: Two-column redesign of photo upload retains the photo selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: Focuses on adoption, the step with the highest drop-off (29.7%), though adoption layout changes have limited historical data (+1.4%).

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Quick Guidance Copy
candidates.change: Revise the final completion screen headline and body to explain basic mouse shortcuts and hiding controls.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets highlighted post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Click and drag to move your companion. Right-click to open actions, switch modes, or hide your pet anytime.

guard.reason: Home intro copy update provides desktop control guidance without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy update on the finish step to reduce confusion, aligned with past non-redesign finish improvements (~+1.5%).

lessons_next: sign_in, copy changes were consistently helpful, winning 4 out of 5 tests (+3.0% average after noise correction).
adoption, redesign changes were helpful in 2 out of 4 tests (+2.3% average after noise correction), while the remaining 2 showed no clear effect.
finish, new_screen changes generally failed after an initial win, with recent tests showing no clear effect or performing worse (-1.3% average).
home, wait_info, home, notification, sign_in, hint, and adoption, layout changes consistently showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
home, new_flow and finish, redesign changes failed across 2 tests each, resulting in no clear effect or worse performance.
Predictions remained generally too optimistic compared to noise-corrected results, and evidence remains thin for categories with only 1 test.
